notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Hibru i no tok husat i kirapim het — KJV i putim 'it', JPS 'my head' — ⟨em⟩ i makim dispela hap.

notes.subject: כשחל
notes.rationale: שחל — tok bilong laion (roar bilong en), sampela i tanim 'laion wol'; hia em i 'laion'.

notes.subject: תתפלא בי
notes.rationale: פלא — wokim samting man i no inap save: Yahwe i soim strong bilong en ananait long Job yet.

translation: Na ⟨em⟩ i kirapim het — olsem laion yu salim mi; na yu kam bek, yu wokim samting man i no inap save long mi.

tokens.gloss: yu wokim samting man i no inap save
